title: Carrier transport at metal/amorphous hafnium-indium-zinc oxide interfaces
supports: Pd on amorphous HIZO: Werner-Guttler mean barrier 1.40 eV with standard deviation 0.14 eV; non-oxide-forming metals (Pd) follow Schottky-Mott while metals that oxidise at the interface give ohmic contacts (via search snippet; resp-diode-tower WebSearch 1/3). Used: high means exist on amorphous oxides, but sigma 0.14 eV gives a 0.54 eV tail penalty (model 12f).

title: beta-Ga2O3 Schottky contacts with oxidised high-work-function metals (Ir, Ru, Pd -> IrO2, RuO2, PdO)
supports: Non-oxidised Pd/Ir/Ru give 1.2-1.4 eV on beta-Ga2O3 and the oxidised anodes higher; exact oxide values not captured (via search snippet; WebSearch 1/3). Supports the Ga2O3 / Ga-rich shell split with RuO2/IrO2 anodes.

title: GaN MSM UV photodetectors with transparent and thermally stable RuO2 and IrO2 Schottky contacts
supports: O2-annealed Ru and Ir contacts on GaN form oxides with Schottky barriers 1.43 eV (Ru) and 1.48 eV (Ir), thermally stable (via search snippet; WebSearch 1/3). Analogue only, not IGZO; used in model 12f.

title: Characteristics of Schottky contacts on n-type 4H-SiC using IrO2 and RuO2
supports: IrO2/RuO2 Schottky barriers >1.9 eV on n-4H-SiC (via search snippet; WebSearch 1/3). Oxide anodes can exceed metal barriers on wide-gap semiconductors.

title: Amorphous RuOx Schottky contacts on InAlN/GaN (ECS 227)
supports: As-deposited amorphous RuOx gives SBH ~0.754 +/- 0.072 eV; vacuum anneal lowers it to 0.546 eV (via search snippet; WebSearch 1/3). Supports RT-DEV-03: reducing anneals strip barrier from oxide anodes.

title: J. Semicond. 2024, 45(7) 072301 (review citing Duan et al., IEDM 2021 vertical CAA IGZO FETs for 2T0C)
supports: IMECAS (Duan et al.) vertical channel-all-around IGZO FETs for 2T0C DRAM with density beyond 4F2 by monolithic stacking, IEDM 2021 / TED 2022 (via search snippet reference list; WebSearch 2/3). Used for RT-PROC-03 stacked 2T top.

title: Huawei has developed 3D DRAM technology
supports: Connecting upper and lower CAA IGZO devices directly shrinks the 2T0C cell to 4F2 (via search snippet; WebSearch 2/3).

title: Vertical integration expands at IEDM
supports: Huawei vertical channel-all-around IGZO transistor with a 50 x 50 nm2 active footprint (via search snippet; WebSearch 2/3). Two such devices fit a 121 nm-pitch pillar.

title: A novel DRAM memory cell with two IGZO-based transistors
supports: imec 2T0C: write transistor + read transistor, read selection via word/bit lines without a third select device (via search snippet; WebSearch 2/3). Basis for removing the read-select FET.

title: A review on reverse-bias leakage current transport mechanisms in metal/GaN Schottky diodes
publisher: Seoul National University of Science and Technology (pure portal)
supports: Poole-Frenkel and thermionic-field emission are generally responsible for reverse leakage in metal/GaN Schottky diodes; several mechanisms act at once (via search snippet; WebSearch 3/3). Supports RT-DEV-02.

title: J. Appl. Phys. 2006 (E. T. Yu group) - ZnO Schottky reverse-current mechanism
supports: Search summary: in single-crystal ZnO Schottky diodes reverse current was dominated by Poole-Frenkel emission rather than Schottky emission, attributed to defects, with local fields enhanced ~5x (via search snippet; attribution of this finding to this URL inferred from the result list, not verified; WebSearch 3/3). Supports RT-DEV-02.

title: IEEE Photonics Journal (Jan 2021) vertical Pt/Gd2O3/GaN diodes
supports: Poole-Frenkel emission dominant in reverse bias with a 0.78 eV trap level (via search snippet; attribution to this URL inferred; WebSearch 3/3).
